digest.component_or_area: review-bot container IAM authorization via instance role
propositions: The review-bot container requires Bedrock credentials through an existing instance role (rebar-gerrit-instance-role) that currently grants only SSM read and KMS decrypt, with no Bedrock permission.

IMDS is reachable from the review-bot container (confirmed by IMDSv2 token PUT returning 200 and instance role resolving), so the solution is IAM-only without requiring metadata_options hop-limit changes.

The Bedrock API action to grant is bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream (not bedrock:Converse), verified by real Converse calls from the instance showing AccessDeniedException when only Converse actions are granted.

The IAM policy scope must include both foundation-model ARNs (arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/anthropic.claude-*) and cross-region inference-profile ARNs (arn:aws:bedrock:*:<account>:inference-profile/*.anthropic.claude-*) to support global inference profiles.
A policy simulator alone cannot determine which IAM action the Bedrock Converse API authorizes against; only a real credentialed call from the instance role reveals the true authorization contract.

The single-owner contract for iam.tf must be preserved: the new Bedrock policy lives in a separate infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf file, not in iam.tf, following the established iam_s2.tf and iam_s4a.tf pattern.
